nodes.label: Ink-to-Composition Model
nodes.description: A computational process that predicts cathode-catalyst-layer composition and wetting descriptors from catalyst, ionomer, pore-structure, wettability, and constituent-density inputs.

nodes.label: Ink-to-Composition Model input dataset
nodes.description: A value-free schema dataset grouping property-valued inputs expected by the Ink-to-Composition Model.

nodes.label: Ink-to-Composition Model scalar-result dataset
nodes.description: A value-free schema dataset grouping scalar property fields produced by the Ink-to-Composition Model.

nodes.label: CCL water-retention-curve dataset
nodes.description: A dataset profile containing the capillary-pressure axis and corresponding CCL water-saturation array.

nodes.label: CCL refined pore-size-distribution dataset
nodes.description: A dataset profile containing a pore-radius axis and corresponding refined CCL pore-size distribution.

nodes.label: CCL contact-angle-distribution dataset
nodes.description: A dataset profile containing a contact-angle-cosine axis and corresponding CCL contact-angle distribution.

nodes.label: Platinum-to-carbon mass ratio
nodes.description: Mass ratio of platinum catalyst to carbon support in the catalyst layer.

nodes.label: Ionomer-to-carbon ratio
nodes.description: Mass ratio of dry ionomer to carbon support in the catalyst layer.

nodes.label: Ionomer-catalyst dispersion parameter
nodes.description: Parameter describing the tendency of ionomer to spread over the platinum-on-carbon surface rather than form larger ionomer aggregates.

nodes.label: Total pore volume
nodes.description: Total volume of primary and secondary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure per unit mass of carbon.

nodes.label: CCL primary-pore volume fraction
nodes.description: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to primary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.

nodes.label: CCL secondary-pore volume fraction
nodes.description: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to secondary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.

nodes.label: CCL primary-pore geometric-mean radius
nodes.description: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for primary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.

nodes.label: CCL secondary-pore geometric-mean radius
nodes.description: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for secondary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.

nodes.label: CCL primary-pore logarithmic radius deviation
nodes.description: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of primary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.

nodes.label: CCL secondary-pore logarithmic radius deviation
nodes.description: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of secondary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.

nodes.label: Carbon-support-induced ionomer alignment degree
nodes.description: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the carbon-support surface.

nodes.label: Platinum-surface-induced ionomer alignment degree
nodes.description: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the platinum surface.

nodes.label: Limiting ionomer alignment degree
nodes.description: Limiting degree of ionomer molecular alignment in a thick film where the influence of the platinum-on-carbon surface is negligible.

nodes.label: Carbon-support water contact angle
nodes.description: Water contact angle of the bare carbon-support surface used to describe its intrinsic wettability.

nodes.label: Platinum-surface water contact angle
nodes.description: Water contact angle of the bare platinum surface used to describe its intrinsic wettability.

nodes.label: Ideal hydrophilic ionomer contact angle
nodes.description: Limiting water contact angle of an ideally hydrophilic aligned ionomer surface used as the hydrophilic endpoint of the model wetting relation.

nodes.label: Ideal hydrophobic ionomer contact angle
nodes.description: Limiting water contact angle of an ideally hydrophobic aligned ionomer surface used as the hydrophobic endpoint of the model wetting relation.

nodes.label: Initial ionomer film thickness
nodes.description: Limiting effective thickness of the ionomer film on the covered platinum-on-carbon surface as ionomer loading approaches zero, representing the characteristic thickness of the first deposited ionomer layer.

nodes.label: Equivalent ionomer patch radius
nodes.description: Equivalent radius representing the characteristic size of finite ionomer patches distributed over the secondary-pore surface.

nodes.label: Platinum particle radius
nodes.description: Radius of the hemispherical platinum nanoparticles used to determine platinum surface coverage in the model.

nodes.label: Surface tension
nodes.description: Surface tension of liquid water at 353 K used to determine capillary flooding behavior in catalyst-layer pores.

nodes.label: Dry ionomer density
nodes.description: Mass density of dry ionomer used to convert ionomer mass into ionomer volume.

nodes.label: Platinum density
nodes.description: Mass density of platinum used to relate platinum loading to the amount and surface coverage of catalyst particles.

nodes.label: Carbon density
nodes.description: Mass density of the carbon-support material.

nodes.label: Capillary-pressure axis data
nodes.description: Array of capillary-pressure values used as the pressure axis for evaluating a cathode-catalyst-layer water-retention curve.

nodes.label: CCL water-saturation data
nodes.description: Array giving the fraction of cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume flooded with liquid water at each capillary pressure in the water-retention curve.

nodes.label: CCL accessible primary-pore volume fraction
nodes.description: Normalized fraction of the remaining accessible cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume belonging to primary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.

nodes.label: CCL accessible secondary-pore volume fraction
nodes.description: Normalized fraction of the remaining accessible cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume belonging to secondary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.

nodes.label: CCL effective ionomer coverage
nodes.description: Fraction of the total secondary-pore surface covered by ionomer in a cathode catalyst layer.

nodes.label: Equivalent ionomer film thickness
nodes.description: Effective uniform thickness of the ionomer film obtained from its volume and the secondary-pore area it covers.

nodes.label: CCL primary-pore specific surface area
nodes.description: Specific surface area of the primary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the primary-pore size distribution.

nodes.label: CCL secondary-pore specific surface area
nodes.description: Specific surface area of the secondary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the secondary-pore size distribution.

nodes.label: CCL total-pore specific surface area
nodes.description: Total specific surface area of the primary- and secondary-pore network of the ionomer-free cathode-catalyst-layer reference structure per unit carbon mass.

nodes.label: CCL ionomer alignment degree
nodes.description: Degree of alignment of ionomer sidechains and backbones after accounting for the platinum-on-carbon surface and the decay of alignment with film thickness.

nodes.label: Platinum-carbon pore-wall contact angle
nodes.description: Effective water contact angle of the uncovered platinum-on-carbon pore wall determined from the surface contributions of platinum and carbon.

nodes.label: Ionomer-coated pore-wall contact angle
nodes.description: Effective water contact angle of an ionomer-coated pore wall determined by the ionomer degree of alignment.

nodes.label: CCL mean contact angle
nodes.description: Arithmetic mean of local cathode-catalyst-layer pore contact angles, with primary- and secondary-pore distributions weighted by their shares of total pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

nodes.label: CCL hydrophilic-pore mean contact angle
nodes.description: Pore-volume-weighted arithmetic mean of contact angles below 90 degrees, considering cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

nodes.label: CCL hydrophobic-pore mean contact angle
nodes.description: Pore-volume-weighted arithmetic mean of contact angles above 90 degrees, considering cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

nodes.label: CCL secondary-pore hydrophobic volume fraction
nodes.description: Fraction of secondary-pore volume with hydrophobic wetting behavior, corresponding to contact angles greater than 90 degrees.

nodes.label: Pore-radius axis data
nodes.description: Array of pore-radius values used as the size axis for evaluating cathode-catalyst-layer pore-size and contact-angle distributions.

nodes.label: CCL refined pore-size-distribution data
nodes.description: Normalized pore-volume density per natural-logarithmic interval of pore radius, combining primary and secondary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.

nodes.label: Contact-angle cosine axis data
nodes.description: Array of contact-angle cosine values used as the angular axis for evaluating the cathode-catalyst-layer contact-angle distribution.

nodes.label: CCL contact-angle-distribution data
nodes.description: Normalized cathode-catalyst-layer contact-angle distribution on the specified cosine grid, combining primary- and secondary-pore contributions.
